Hello, I would like you to design an outfit and hairstyle(if possible) for an OC, Wrenn.

She appears like a young adult, taking care to maintain her appearance and presentation, but her real origins and age are known only to a few. 

Outwardly she is cordial and easy to approach, and possesses a supernatural charisma that allows her to charm almost anyone she encounters. Those who have seen her true self are far and few between, but she holds those in her inner circle close to her heart. She has a periodical craving for emotional intimacy that must be satisfied, and those who can truly get through to her are far and few between. When freed from her duties she is rather easygoing and witty, and is very good at taking care of people.

I'd like you to design something that is ornate, but still contemporary. Please make sure that there is some form of legwear like stockings or thigh-highs. Please refer to the material attached. Thank you for your time and consideration.
